requirements.statement: The canonical agent-orientation surface SHALL prohibit treating technical write capability as authority, require exact candidate/evidence inspection before mutation, and require post-cutover persistent framework mutation to route through Governance.
FS0 SHALL NOT infer that one GitHub/repository state class has another state class's semantics merely because the states coincide.
Canonical bootstrap maintenance data SHALL provide the maintained source required to derive FS0 artifacts.
Successor Design Proposal source data SHALL remain machine-resolvably identifiable as a distinct canonical bootstrap source role.
Bootstrap-created maintained artifacts SHALL be generated from canonical maintenance data by separately identified generator implementation.
Generated FS0 read and operating surfaces SHALL NOT be independently maintained as canonical source.
Generation SHALL be deterministic for identical canonical inputs and explicitly declared variable inputs.
FS0 SHALL have one machine-resolvable canonical maintenance-data source role for generated FS0 artifacts.
FS0 semantic and realization choices required for generation SHALL be represented in canonical maintenance data rather than embedded in generator code.
Generator code SHALL NOT independently define FS0 normative semantics.
The FS0 generation source registry SHALL remain non-authoritative maintenance metadata.
Bootstrap source SHALL NOT replace an accepted generated read surface as authority when source and read surface disagree.
Post-cutover FS0 maintenance that modifies bootstrap source SHALL occur only through Governance-authorized work.
Each uniquely identified normative requirement SHALL express exactly one primary normative obligation.
Each normative requirement statement SHALL contain no more than 300 characters.
Material normative semantics SHALL NOT be omitted solely to satisfy the requirement-statement length bound.
Generated FS0 read surfaces SHALL be produced from canonical maintenance data by the identified generation implementation.
Every bootstrap-created maintained FS0 generated artifact SHALL be reproducible from its canonical maintenance data and identified generation implementation.
Each generated successor Design Proposal artifact SHALL be reproducible from canonical proposal source data and identified generation implementation.
